v.title: Hull’s Last‑Gasp Heroics Shock Brighton, Leave Premier League in Turmoil
v.excerpt: Hull’s McBurnie double stuns Brighton, turning a 10‑man deficit into a Premier League upset that could reshape the title race.
v.body:
## Quick take
Oli McBurnie’s stoppage‑time double sent Hull City to a stunning 2‑1 victory over second‑placed Brighton, turning a 10‑man deficit into a triumph that will echo across the Premier League.

## What happened
The match began with Brighton dominating possession, but Hull’s relentless pressing paid dividends in the 85th minute when McBurnie struck a powerful header to level the score. The hosts were down to ten men after a red card in the 72nd minute, yet they never wavered. In the dying seconds, McBurnie found the back of the net again, this time a curling shot from outside the box that slipped past Brighton’s goalkeeper, sealing the upset.

The drama unfolded with Brighton’s midfield scrambling to contain Hull’s counter‑attacks. Despite being a man down, the hosts’ defense held firm, and the final minutes saw them launch a series of dangerous set‑pieces. McBurnie’s composure under pressure was the decisive factor, turning what could have been a mere consolation goal into a headline‑making win.

## Why it matters
- **Premier League table shake‑up** – Brighton’s loss means the gap to the title‑contending teams widens, while Hull’s unexpected win boosts their confidence and keeps them in the relegation battle, forcing managers to rethink tactics.
- **McBurnie’s rising star** – The striker’s clutch performance positions him as a potential breakout talent, making him a player to watch in future transfer windows and for national team selectors.
- **Impact on Barcelona’s scouting network** – With the Premier League’s unpredictability highlighted, Barcelona’s scouts may revisit the league’s depth, considering players like McBurnie who thrive in high‑pressure moments.

## What's next
Hull’s coach will now need to decide whether to maintain the aggressive, high‑pressing style that produced this victory or to recalibrate for consistency. Fans should focus on the upcoming fixture against a mid‑table side, where Hull must prove they can replicate this form without the element of surprise. Meanwhile, Brighton will look to bounce back quickly, and their next match will be a litmus test for their resilience after this shocking defeat.
